test_title: PYST 23: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - General Intelligence (Held On 15 Mar 2022 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series will complete the series.

k _ d q _ c _ m _ q y _ k m _ q _ c

options.text: m y k y c d y
m y k d c k y
m y k d c d y
m y k d c d m

solution:
Given: k _ d q _ c _ m _ q y _ k m _ q _ c

1. m y k y c d y → k **m** d q **y** c - **k** m **y** q y **c -** k m **d** q **y** c

2. m y k d c k y → k m d q y c - k m **d** q y c - k m **k** q y c

3. m y k d c d y → k m d q y c - k m **d** q y c - k m d q y c

4. m y k d c d m → k m d q y c - k m **d** q y c - k m d q **m** c

 
• Option (3) follow the cycle of **"kmdqyc/kmdqyc/kmdqyc"**

Hence, the correct answer is **"m, y, k, d, c, d, y".**
